topic: Sudden vision loss in one eye = emergency (go to hospital immediately)

youtube.title: One eye suddenly went dark? Go to hospital NOW 🚨 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Sudden vision loss in one eye is an emergency.
ஒரு கண் திடீரெனத் தெரியவில்லையா? உடனே மருத்துவமனைக்குச் செல்லுங்கள்!

• The retina needs a constant blood supply; a blocked vessel can cause damage within hours.
• Sign 1: sudden blur or loss of sight in one eye, even without pain.
• Sign 2: a dark curtain or shadow moving across your vision.
• Sign 3: sight goes for a few minutes and comes back. Still urgent: it can be a warning sign of stroke.
• With a drooping face, weak arm or slurred speech, call 108 immediately.
• Don't wait to see if it improves. Go to a hospital emergency department.
• If you have diabetes or high BP, get a yearly eye test.

gmb.text: Sudden loss of vision in one eye is an emergency. Go to a hospital immediately. The retina needs a constant blood supply, and if a blood vessel is blocked, damage can begin within hours. Watch for three signs: sudden blur or loss of sight in one eye, even without pain; a dark curtain or shadow moving across your vision; and sight that disappears for a few minutes and then returns, which can be a warning sign of stroke. If vision loss comes with a drooping face, a weak arm or slurred speech, call 108 right away. This is general information, not a diagnosis. Get routine eye checks every year, especially if you have diabetes or high BP. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
